EmailTemplate.subject: We missed you at our Higher Ed webinar
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
We missed you! Our recent webinar, “Higher Ed at a Crossroads: Navigating the Enrollment Cliff & Policy Shifts to Drive Success,” presented in collaboration with EY-Parthenon and the University of Massachusetts, highlighted trends affecting higher education enrollment and ways that institutions can use enrollment data to drive strategic decision-making in today’s dynamic market. As promised, please find our webinar recording and slideshow presentation linked below:
- Watch the recording <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-recording-navigating-the-enrollment-cliff-policy-shifts-to-drive-success]]>
- View the presentation slides <[[https://more.flywire.com/rs/372-QSQ-649/images/Webinar - Flywire EY UMass.pdf?version=0]]>
Want to learn more? We invite you to join us at Flywire Fusion <[[https://fusion.flywire.com/event/64962232-142e-4223-acb4-7a9cfb76b730/summary]]>, our U.S. education client conference and awards ceremony, where we will continue the conversation on enrollment and other hot industry topics. Have questions? If you are a Flywire client, please contact your Relationship Manager. If not, simply reply to this email and we’ll connect you with someone who can help.
Thanks, The Flywire Team Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
